The selection requires $Q^2 > 150$~GeV$^2$; only hadrons within the central tracking region, $|\eta_h| < 1.6$, are included. The tabulated entries are cross sections divided by the bin volume in $Q^2$, $x$, $z$ and $p_{T,h}$, in units of nb~GeV$^{-3}$; the bin volume is given in the last column of the table, and the entries are a derived view of the tabulated integrated cross sections. For the bins whose upper $x$ edge lies above $1$, only the range up to $x = 1$ enters the bin volume. The values are Born-level cross sections: they are corrected for detector effects and for radiative (QED and electroweak) effects, with $Z$-boson exchange included in the correction convention. Each cross section is quoted with its statistical uncertainty and its total systematic uncertainty. Two correction factors are tabulated for reference: the factor applied in this table (sixth column), which includes $Z$-boson exchange, and the corresponding factor of the photon-exchange-only convention (seventh column); the ratio of the two factors converts a cross section between the two conventions. In this block the physical range of $x$ ends at $x = 1$; the bin volume given in the last column of the table uses this physical limit. The values are preliminary and subject to change.}
